canonical.title: A Saturday at Victor's Fine Dining — weekending Perl-Nennig

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of Victor's Fine Dining by Christian Bau
siblings.summary: What to do in the radius around Christian Bau's three-star Victor's Fine Dining in Perl-Nennig — Roman mosaics, Saarschleife, Mosel wine, Schengen and the Trier add-on.

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near Victor's Fine Dining by Christian Bau
siblings.summary: Four lodging options inside Nennig village within walking distance of Victor's Fine Dining — only one is on-property; the rest are 10–13 minutes on foot.

siblings.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of Victor's Fine Dining by Christian Bau
siblings.summary: Nine distinctive places to sleep within a reasonable taxi of Christian Bau's three-star table in Perl-Nennig — castles, tree houses, a Jugendstil villa, a cross-border boutique spa.

sources.title: Victor's Fine Dining — opening hours & creative pauses
sources.claim: Thu–Sun dinner, Sat–Sun lunch, last orders 20:00, creative pauses 18 May–7 Jun and 21 Sep–4 Oct 2026; 3 Michelin stars since 2005.

sources.title: Victor's Fine Dining — contact
sources.claim: Schloßstraße 27–29, 66706 Perl-Nennig; +49 6866 79-118.

sources.title: Victor's Fine Dining — FAQ (room booking offer)
sources.claim: FAQ states the restaurant will book a Schloss Berg room with the dinner reservation.

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide — Victor's Fine Dining by Christian Bau
sources.claim: Three Michelin stars.

sources.title: Victor's Residenz-Hotel Schloss Berg — rooms
sources.claim: 106 rooms / 11 categories across a Renaissance castle and a Mediterranean villa, same address as the restaurant.

sources.title: Schloss Berg — restaurants & bars
sources.claim: Victor's Fine Dining sits in the castle building, a few metres from the villa rooms.

sources.title: Bacchus — Schloss Berg's casual Italian sister restaurant
sources.claim: Upscale Italian/Mediterranean kitchen on-property; an option if the three-star is closed.

sources.title: MICHELIN Guide hotels — Schloss Berg
sources.claim: Listed in the MICHELIN Guide hotels collection.

sources.title: Schloss Berg — Tripadvisor review summary
sources.claim: Recent reviews flag dated furnishings, no central A/C, noisy portable units; breakfast praised.

sources.title: Schloss Berg — Expedia listing
sources.claim: Villa rooms have gilded headboards and Roman-antiquity art; castle rooms have canopied beds.

sources.title: Hotel Zur Traube — official site
sources.claim: Bübinger Straße 22, 66706 Perl-Nennig, on-site restaurant, EV charger, free parking.

sources.title: Hotel Zur Traube — Tripadvisor
sources.claim: 3.9/5 across 49 reviews; ~11 min walk from Victor's; $179–$244/night; 21 rooms.

sources.title: Hôtel Château Schengen — official site
sources.claim: Renovated historic château reopened June 2024 across the Moselle in Schengen, Luxembourg.

sources.title: Château Schengen — relaunch profile
sources.claim: 17 rooms with 13 more planned; restaurant across four historic rooms seating up to 180; JBM group takeover 2024.

sources.title: Château de Schengen — history (Wikipedia)
sources.claim: 1390 castle, rebuilt as a manor 1812; Victor Hugo sketched the old tower in 1871.

sources.title: Hotel Villa Hügel Trier — official site
sources.claim: 1914 Jugendstil villa, 4-star superior, 45 rooms plus an adults-only Relax wing with rooftop pool.

sources.title: Becker's Hotel Trier-Olewig — official site
sources.claim: 4-star design hotel + historic wine house, two restaurants, own vineyard.

sources.title: Domaine la Forêt Remich — official site
sources.claim: 4-star Remich hotel, 16 rooms, MICHELIN-recommended restaurant, 700 m² spa; doubles from €150.

sources.title: Schloss Saareck Mettlach — official site
sources.claim: 1902–03 castle on the Saar; Villeroy & Boch guesthouse since 1954; 22 rooms themed on V&B tableware lines.

sources.title: Saarschleifenlodge — eco-certified loft/tree-house property
sources.claim: Lofts, suites, tiny houses and tree houses in Mettlach-Dreisbach.

sources.title: Roman Villa Nennig — Visit Saarland
sources.claim: 160 m² Roman mosaic of 3M+ tesserae, discovered 1852, one of very few mosaics north of the Alps still at its original site.

sources.title: Mahlknopf Roman tumulus — Saarschleifenland
sources.claim: 44.5 m diameter 2nd-century burial mound modelled on Augustus's tomb in Rome; largest Roman tumulus in the Trier region.

sources.title: Roman Villa Borg — Germany Tourism
sources.claim: World's only fully reconstructed Roman villa rustica — manor house, baths, gardens, gate house, tavern; 9.7 km from Schloss Berg.

sources.title: Villa Borg — Roman Taverne
sources.claim: Taverne serves Roman-recipe dishes (lentil stew, roast ham with fig sauce, home-baked Roman bread) in a banquet hall.

sources.title: Treetop Walk Saarschleife — official site
sources.claim: 1,250 m canopy walkway culminating in a 42 m observation tower at Cloef-Atrium; low-barrier (max 6% gradient).

sources.title: The Cloef viewpoint — Saarschleifenland
sources.claim: Rocky viewpoint 180 m above the Saar at the apex of the loop; 'Kleine Cloef' 500 m further along; 'Cloef' is Celtic for 'steep cliff'.

sources.title: European Museum Schengen — opening hours
sources.claim: Daily 10:00–18:00 in 2026; Schengen Museum closes 15:00 on 27 April 2026; Tourist Info closed 1 Nov 2026.

sources.title: Visit Schengen — admission
sources.claim: Museum + boat €5 adult, €3 ages 7–17, under-6 free; LuxembourgPass & ICOM free.

sources.title: Schengen Museum — Visit Moselle
sources.claim: Permanent exhibition on the 1985 Schengen Agreement; MS Princesse Marie-Astrid moored a short walk away.

sources.title: MS Princesse Marie-Astrid return — Luxembourg.public.lu
sources.claim: 1985 signing ship returned to Schengen in 2025 as Prinzessin Marie-Astrid Europa, inaugurated 14 June 2025.

sources.title: Remich — CroisiEurope guide
sources.claim: Caves St-Martin founded 1919; underground cellar tours explain sparkling-wine production.

sources.title: Domaines Vinsmoselle — cellar visits
sources.claim: ~1-hour cellar tours year-round (ex harvest), including Art Deco Poll-Fabaire crémant cellar at Wormeldange.

sources.title: Domaines Vinsmoselle — wine tourism
sources.claim: Four cellar sites along the Luxembourg Moselle: Remerschen, Wellenstein, Wormeldange, Grevenmacher.

sources.title: Weingut Van Volxem — tastings
sources.claim: Vinothek Wed–Sun 11:00–17:00; commentated counter tastings without reservation; 8 m panoramic glass over the Scharzhofberg.

sources.title: Weingut Forstmeister Geltz-Zilliken — Saarburg
sources.claim: 11th-generation VDP estate, 8-wine tastings €25/person by appointment, redeemable on purchase.

sources.title: Weingut Peter Lauer — Ayl
sources.claim: VDP estate; Florian Lauer farms 12 ha of slate-rich Saar vineyards incl. Ayler Kupp.

sources.title: Saarburg waterfall — Visit Mosel
sources.claim: 20 m Leukbach waterfall cascading through the medieval old town; freely accessible from Buttermarkt platforms.

sources.title: Burg Saarburg — hilltop castle ruin
sources.claim: Hilltop ruin first mentioned 964 AD; >100 keep steps to a Saar-valley panorama; restaurant in the bailey.

sources.title: Villeroy & Boch Erlebniszentrum — visitor info
sources.claim: Keravision exhibition inside the former Benedictine Alte Abtei tracks 260+ years of ceramic history.

sources.title: Villeroy & Boch Factory Outlet — Mettlach
sources.claim: Up to 30% off retail; weekdays 9:30–19:00, Sundays 14:00–18:00.

sources.title: Mondorf Domaine Thermal — official site
sources.claim: 45 ha thermal park; spa fed by 36 °C strongly mineralised spring; baths, saunas, fitness, 4-star superior hotel.

sources.title: Mondorf Domaine Thermal — spa hours
sources.claim: Spa Mon–Fri 10–20, Sat 09–20, Sun/holidays 09–18; hotel access changes from 20 March 2026.

sources.title: Lohengrin — Saint-Nicolas Remich
sources.claim: Refined French cuisine, prize-winning sommelier, panoramic Mosel views.

sources.title: Luxembourg public transport — free since 2020
sources.claim: All buses, trams and 2nd-class trains in Luxembourg are free for residents and tourists since 1 March 2020.

sources.title: Porta Nigra Trier — official info
sources.claim: Best-preserved Roman city gate north of the Alps; €6 adults / €3 children; partial scaffolding during restoration.

sources.title: Trier ↔ Perl distance
sources.claim: Road distance Trier–Perl is 44–48 km.

sources.title: Moselsteig Stage 1 — Perl → Palzem
sources.claim: Stage 1 starts in Perl, passes Nennig & the Roman mosaic, offers tri-country views (DE/LU/FR).

sources.title: Saarweinfest Saarburg — official
sources.claim: 5–7 September 2026; Saarburg old town becomes a wine street with Saar-Obermosel wine-queen coronation, fireworks, Sunday parade.

sources.title: SaarRieslingSommer — official
sources.claim: 29–30 Aug 2026, 10 wineries Serrig–Konz-Filzen, cellars open 12:00–18:00, shuttle service.
